Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Thai** | 1230 W. 31st St., Chicago, IL 60647 | Pad Thai (vegetarian version), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian) |
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W. 31st St., Chicago, IL 60647 | Green Curry (vegetarian), Stir‑fried Tofu, Vegetable Spring Rolls |
| **Siam Square** | 1220 W. 31st St., Chicago, IL 60647 | Pad See Ew (vegetarian), Thai Basil Tofu, Vegetarian Satay |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1230 W. 31st St., Chicago, IL 60647 | Pad Krapow (vegetarian), Thai Red Curry (vegetarian), Vegetarian Spring Rolls |

All of these locations are in the same general area (West Loop / West Side), so you can choose based on your exact location or preference. If you’d like more options or specific menu details, let me know!
